entries.notes: R 栏“bol.”含义未明，无法佐证，据 H 到、M cañ(=kân) 及 L llegare 释“到达”

entries.en: to reach; to come up to; to extend to
to arrive at some place; to come (to a place)
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（泡/到），M 长例句中一处音写污損难辨；据 L“llegar a alguna parte”与 M 诸例（…tâū…lāy）释“到达某处”

entries.en: to go to, attend (a place); to arrive in good time

entries.zh: 到达（受审/定夺之处）；释义存疑
entries.en: to arrive at the judgment (per L); uncertain
entries.notes: H“敷”（涂敷、铺施义）与 L“llegar a el juicio”语义不协，或系“赴”之形讹，未能定夺

entries.en: to go to; to approach; to take up (a post/duty)

entries.zh: 呈送到案受审；释义存疑
entries.en: (per L) for something to be brought to judgment; uncertain
entries.notes: L 栏存疑（algara/alguna cosa），H“額”（kân-jieg）与词头语义不协，未能定夺

entries.zh: 侵；逼近（如借使节斡旋而接近）
entries.en: to come near; to encroach, invade; to approach by means of an envoy
entries.notes: L“aoraue”当为 ahora que，展开依赖推断；核心义“接近”由 H 侵、M 三读（chiêm/chîm/chiam）互证

entries.en: to arrive; to fall due (of a date/term); to have arrived, be fulfilled
to come; to arrive at a place
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（泡/到），据 M tâu lāy(=thàu-lâi) 与 L“llegar alguna parte”释“到来”

entries.en: to come (walking) to a place; to draw near and arrive
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（近/行），次字存疑（泡/到），据 M quīn tâū lāy 释“行至某处”

entries.en: (of a ship) to arrive safe and sound
one's fortune to arrive; one's luck/time to come
to come to a place; to arrive (by way of/along)
entries.notes: H 次字存疑（泡/到），据 H 搭、来与 M tâu tâū lāy 释“搭至某处”

entries.en: to come to a place; to arrive
entries.notes: H 次字存疑（泡/到），据 H 到、来与 M cañ tâū lāy 释“到某处来”

entries.en: to reach up to, touch; to reach (as high as) the sky
to reach/touch the body (per L); uncertain
entries.notes: L 栏“ot el radio”残乱难解，H“私”（tâ sû）与 cuerpo 语义不协，未能定夺
